suite: Arrival presentation / real playback and scrub wall-time
scope: Offline workbench + shared production Worker/WebGL, not React root

cases.name: Both controls have defaults and no automatic re-solving
Changing timing never changes camera, snapshot, progress or geometry
Actual RAF playback reaches UV and keeps landed island at full colour
Fade continues with real time while successor animates
Stationary held scrub still runs its hold and fade
64x leaves hold seconds unchanged and does not lengthen the queue
Reverse playback does not relight old arrivals
Input validation keeps empty controls from injecting NaN
No camera resets, unexpected UV jobs or errors
